name: Selenon Rising
source:
Selenon Rising is an episodic mystery visual novel with a noir style. 

Hundreds of years have passed since Earth lost the war against the Selenon, terrifying alien beings who live on the dark side of the Moon. Now, the Bureau of Human Protection presides over the last vestiges of the human race. The Selenon have kept one city intact, but mercilessly enforce a single law - any advanced technology must be destroyed. 

Violet is an agent of SPECTRA, and one of the City's few psychics - humans who were granted the powers of the Selenon. She and her partner Blue have been given a new assignment - find the culprit of a murder that could be linked to the New Moon Resistance, a group of freedom fighters who want to stop the Selenon at any cost. It seems clear-cut, but things are never that easy. 

Their investigation leads to a web of secrets that may reveal humanity's ultimate fate. But first, Violet must discover them before it is too late.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/358760/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Selenon Rising》是一部黑色电影风格的分章式悬疑视觉小说。

地球输给塞勒农的战争已经过去数百年。塞勒农是生活在月球暗面的可怕外星生物。如今，人类保护局统治着人类最后的残余。塞勒农保留了一座完整的城市，却无情地执行一条法律：所有先进技术都必须销毁。

维奥莱特是SPECTRA的特工，也是城里少数的灵能者之一——这些人获得了塞勒农的力量。她与搭档布鲁接到新任务：找出一宗谋杀案的凶手，而案件可能与新月抵抗军有关。那是一群不惜一切代价也要阻止塞勒农的自由战士。事情看似一目了然，但一切从来没有那么简单。

调查将他们引向一张秘密交织的网络，其中或许藏着人类最终命运的答案。但首先，维奥莱特必须在一切太迟之前揭开真相。

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/358760/]Steam[/url]]
